title: College Panda Ch 4 + Ch 7 mixed (3/3): equation types and interpreting models

questions.stem: $$T=56+5h$$ The given equation models the temperature $T$ of a room, in degrees Fahrenheit, $h$ hours after a heater is turned on. According to the model, the temperature of the heated room increases by how many degrees Fahrenheit every 30 minutes?
$$6x=x-3x(2n-1)$$ In the given equation, $n$ is a constant. The equation has infinitely many solutions. What is the value of $n$?

Olivia sells figurines and ships them in small and large packages. It takes her 10 minutes to prepare each small package and 15 minutes to prepare each large package. The graph represents the possible combinations of the number of small packages and the number of large packages Olivia can prepare in exactly $k$ minutes. What is the value of $k$?

figures.alt: Fourteen points on a falling line: (0, 26), (3, 24), (6, 22), ..., (36, 2), (39, 0). x-axis: Number of small packages, 0 to 39 in steps of 3. y-axis: Number of large packages, 0 to 26 in steps of 2.

questions.stem: $$|x|=x$$ How many solutions does the given equation have?

A tank initially contained 204 gallons of water. After a hole was punched in the tank, the amount of water in the tank decreased at a constant rate each minute until 36 gallons of water remained. The equation $204-4.2x=36$ represents this situation, where $x$ is the number of minutes after the hole was punched. Which is the best interpretation of the number $4.2$ in this context?

options.A: The percentage decrease in the amount of water in the tank
options.B: The rate at which water left the tank, in gallons per minute
options.C: The number of minutes it took for every 1-gallon decrease in the amount of water in the tank
options.D: The total decrease, in gallons, in the amount of water in the tank $x$ minutes after the hole was punched

questions.stem: The expressions $bx^2+11x$ and $x(4x+a)-3x$, where $a$ and $b$ are constants, are equivalent. What is the value of $a+b$?

A recipe suggests sweetening honey tea with sugar according to the equation $s=10-2h$, where $s$ is the amount of sugar, in teaspoons, that should be added to a tea beverage containing $h$ teaspoons of honey. What is the best interpretation of $2$ in this context?

options.A: For every teaspoon of honey in the beverage, two more teaspoons of sugar should be added.
options.B: For every teaspoon of honey in the beverage, two fewer teaspoons of sugar should be added.
options.C: For every two teaspoons of honey in the beverage, one more teaspoon of sugar should be added.
options.D: For every two teaspoons of honey in the beverage, one fewer teaspoon of sugar should be added.

questions.stem: $$ax-b=3(2x+1)$$ In the given equation, $a$ and $b$ are constants. The equation has no solution. Which of the following could be the values of $a$ and $b$?

$$A=\frac{7}{2}(9+x)$$ The function $A$ gives the area, in square inches, of a trapezoid with a height of $7$ inches, a shorter base of $9$ inches, and a longer base of $x$ inches. If the length of the longer base is increased by $5$ inches, by how many square inches does the area of the trapezoid increase?
$$\frac{2}{3}ax+3=\frac{8}{3}x+9b$$ In the given equation, $a$ and $b$ are constants. The equation has infinitely many solutions. What is the value of $\frac{a}{b}$?
A seafood vendor earned \$725 for selling $a$ pounds of fish and $b$ pounds of shrimp. The equation $12a+18b=725$ represents this situation. What is the best interpretation of $18b$ in this context?

options.A: The total number of shrimp the vendor sold
options.B: The total weight, in pounds, of all the fish and shrimp the vendor sold
options.C: The total amount, in dollars, the vendor earned for $b$ pounds of shrimp sold
options.D: The total amount, in dollars, the vendor earned for each pound of shrimp sold

questions.stem: $$2|10-4x|+9=77$$ What is the sum of the solutions to the given equation?

$$h(t)=100-4t$$ The given function $h$ models the number of hours until a gallon of milk held at a temperature of $t$, in degrees Celsius, goes sour. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the number $4$ in this context?

options.A: An increase of $1^\circ$C will make a gallon of milk go sour 4 hours faster.
options.B: An increase of $1^\circ$C will make 4 gallons of milk go sour 1 hour faster.
options.C: An increase of $4^\circ$C will make a gallon of milk go sour 1 hour faster.
options.D: An increase of $4^\circ$C will make a gallon of milk go sour 4 hours faster.

questions.stem: The expression $5x^5+6x^4-8x^3$ can be rewritten as $(x^3-hx^2)(5x^2+10x)$, where $h$ is a constant. What is the value of $h$?

Jamil reached the end of a 26-mile track by walking at a speed of 5 miles per hour and running at a faster speed than he walked. The equation $5t+9(4-t)=26$ represents this situation, where $t$ is the total amount of time, in hours, Jamil spent walking. Which of the following is the best interpretation of $4$ in this context?

options.A: The total distance, in miles, that Jamil ran
options.B: The speed at which Jamil ran, in miles per hour
options.C: The total number of hours Jamil spent running
options.D: The total number of hours Jamil spent walking and running

questions.stem: $$\frac{1}{3}(bx+c)=\frac{14}{27}x+\frac{4}{9}$$ In the given equation, $b$ and $c$ are constants and $c>3$. The equation has no solution. What is the value of $b$?
$$\sqrt{-x}=x$$ How many distinct real solutions does the given equation have?
$$18x^2-8=2(ax+b)(ax-b)$$ In the given equation, $a$ and $b$ are constants. If the equation is true for all values of $x$, which of the following could be the value of $ab$?
